THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Average fixed cost, average variable cost, and average total cost express costs per unit of output. Average total cost equals average fixed cost plus average variable cost. Average fixed cost falls as output spreads the same fixed cost across more units, while average variable cost changes with the productivity and price of variable inputs.

Average total cost equals average fixed cost plus average variable cost.
Average fixed cost falls continuously as output spreads the same fixed cost across more units.
Use per-unit measures only when output is positive.
